hooks.prompt: Per .guidelines/process.md: "Nye features skal i TODO før implementering". The tool input describes an edit/write. Is this implementing a NEW FEATURE (not a bugfix, typo, config change, dependency update, or refactoring of existing code)? If NO (bugfix, typo, etc.) → allow. If YES (new feature): check whether the project's TODO.md file already has an entry covering this feature. If TODO.md covers it → allow. If TODO.md is missing this feature → block with a reminder in Danish that the feature skal tilføjes til TODO.md før implementering. Tool input: $ARGUMENTS
